title: Run beside the SNS email, then show Ryan
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** M1, first slice

**Goal.** End of the first slice. Replaces kanbus-6275db. The SNS email keeps going; both run, and we compare.

**Build.**
- Deploy after `PPY-d21c7f`. Reconcile opens the seven alarms already firing (2026-11-04 reading) as grouped messages. Expect new mail about Amplify site alarms that have no actions today; that is the point, and the catalog gets fixed from what Ryan says.
- Compare with the SNS email for at least one real alarm. Post per-day message counts on each path.
- `docs/operator-alerts.md`: runbook. Adding a catalog entry, redrive, what the dead-man means, how to deploy.
- Nothing is removed here.

**Acceptance.**
Ryan confirms he could act on a real alarm from the message alone; comparison recorded on `PPY-4d1143`.

**Depends on:** PPY-e92c8e, PPY-dd8c18
